seeds.title: @{-1} and @ pass the ref check
seeds.detail: git check-ref-format --branch expands @{-1} to the previous branch inside a repo, and accepts @. A working sample named @ or @{-1} passes where R-037 intends a refusal. The plan lists this risk. Fix: reject a sample that starts with @ or equals @, or run git check-ref-format without --branch.

seeds.title: catastrophic regex blocks judge
seeds.detail: (a+)+$ against a 28 character sample ran 9.9 seconds in re. The spec accepts this. A preflight over many samples could stall. Send to verify-limits.

seeds.title: judge raises TypeError for a non-string sample
seeds.detail: ref_format_error(None) and (5) raise TypeError from subprocess. Samples are strings by contract, so this is outside the threat model.
